visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair is in a room with a white door and beige walls. He is wearing a white button-down shirt and looks into the camera, touching his hair. He then puts on a pair of black frames. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor garden during the day. The man is wearing sunglasses and holding a printed document, pointing at it. Green trees and a beige house are in the background. (3) The man walks along a concrete path in the garden, swaying his arms and gesturing as if talking. He is still wearing the white shirt and sunglasses. (4) He brings his hand up to the frames of his glasses, touching the side temple. He looks directly at the camera with a slight smile. (5) Close-up shots of four pairs of glasses (red and black frames) resting on a surface next to a tan case. The camera pans across them, showing the small circular camera lenses on the front corners. (6) A screen recording of a smartphone application interface titled '日常智慧助理' (Daily Smart Assistant) is shown, displaying various icons like news, recipes, and maps. (7) The man is walking on a suburban sidewalk next to a road with moving cars. He points to his glasses while talking. (8) A split screen appears showing the man on the left and a smartphone screen on the right displaying a call interface with the name 'Eric Chen'. (9) The man stands in front of a storefront with a sign in Korean and English 'Myeongdong Soon Tofu'. He looks up and points towards the sign. (10) A first-person view (POV) shows hands tamping coffee grounds into a portafilter and placing it into an espresso machine. (11) A series of still photos are shown, including cars in a parking lot at night and a store interior. (12) The man is back in the garden, holding a pair of transparent glasses and demonstrating how they can be swapped.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An East Asian male with short black hair, wearing a white long-sleeved button-down shirt and black-framed glasses/sunglasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A residential indoor room with a white door; a lush backyard garden with green trees, white fences, and blue skies; a suburban street with moving cars; a restaurant exterior with signs in Korean; an indoor kitchen with coffee equipment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins over a driving electronic beat with a strong 4/4 rhythm. A sharp digital 'Whoosh' sounds during the first cut. (2) Ambient birds and distant garden atmosphere are heard as the speaker continues in a narrative tone. Music maintains a consistent tempo. (3) A distinct 'Ding' sound accompanies the appearance of variety text. Narration remains rapid and enthusiastic. (4) The audio texture shifts to simulate a phone call, with a slight low-pass filter effect on a female voice responding. BGM ducks slightly to favor speech clarity. (5) A series of quick digital UI 'Clicks' occur as the screen recording section begins. (6) A sharp 'Beep' sounds during the translation demo, followed by a synthetic voice readout. (7) Percussive sounds of a coffee tamper and the mechanical hum of an espresso machine are heard in the POV section, layered with the ongoing BGM. (8) The video concludes with the speaker's tone rising in pitch for a final recommendation, followed by a quick musical swell and a clean cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature 1 (Translation) -> Feature 2 (Calls) -> Feature 3 (Audio) -> Feature 4 (POV) -> Closing.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an advertisement and practical demonstration for the HTC VIVE AI glasses (VIVE Eagle). It uses a humorous '注意看' (Look closely) style hook to grab attention, then transitions into showing how the product solves real-world problems like language barriers, noisy phone calls, and the need for private music listening, eventually encouraging viewers to consider purchasing.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, naming the brand multiple times, showing the brand logo, and a final recommendation '推薦給大家'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses popular short-form video editing tropes (Meme-style text, fast cuts) to present technical features in a relatable, lifestyle-oriented way. The audio quality shifts between studio narration and phone-mic simulation to emphasize the 'directional microphone' feature.
